# Due dates, Fall 2026

Every deadline in the course, in Mountain Time (America/Denver). Homework and the finite element analysis (FEA) lab writeups are due at 5:00 pm unless a row says otherwise; pre-class check-ins are due at noon on the day of the week's first lecture; class questions are answered in the room during the last ten minutes of class. The exam windows and the project milestones are in [syllabus.md](syllabus.md) under Key dates. Canvas is the authority if this file and Canvas ever disagree.
